content: The eye never carries the load; it only watches and fears how much the head must bear.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: When you look at a massive pile of firewood or a towering challenge, your imagination magnifies the weight ten times over, paralyzing you with dread. But once the head actually lifts the basket, muscles engage, rhythm takes over, and the burden is carried with dignity. Action cures anxiety.
practicalInsight: Stop staring in horror at that daunting mountain of work today. Pick up the first bundle and start walking.
reflectionPrompt: How much needless suffering are you creating by staring at your problems instead of engaging them?
